4311-4871-5220-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4311-4871-5220-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3263-5226-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
3263-5226-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Lithatog.

553-7467-7735.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Quicksilver.
In response, cast Sudden Setback by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

2034-3499-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

955-2457-4289-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2523-2869-4089.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Glasspool Mimic that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Glasspool Mimic token instead.
2523-2869-4089.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

252-4871-5434.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4871-5434.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

4222-4289-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {U}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3317-5231-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3317-5231-5972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1734-4605-6797-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1594-4331-4993-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

4677-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

876-1723-2512.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting a creature that doesn't currently have Lightning Greaves attached.
If the targeted creature was a Cleric, Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Starlit Sanctum's second ability by paying {W}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

2034-3661-4053-6989.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3558-4053-5231-6989.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2478-4730.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mishra's Bauble.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sparring Mummy.
When Sparring Mummy enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

224-907-3314-3430-5478.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {G} and/or {W}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-907-3314-3430-5478.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

380-413-3362.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it, Blasting Station and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
If you returned a Dragon this way, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing token's trigger, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-3975-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

5686-6014-6659.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain triggers, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1202-1737-4853-5256.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling target player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3388-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Moritte of the Frost has a power of at least 2.
2713-3388-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Moritte of the Frost and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Moritte of the Frost to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1238-2351-2921-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

101-2781-4617-4906-6084.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You have not activated Soulbright Flamekin's ability more than twice this turn.
101-2781-4617-4906-6084.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting each other creature you control except Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the copies of Felidar Guardian's trigger targeting Soulbright Flamekin and Vampire Charmseeker, blinking Soulbright Flamekin and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Deflecting Swat from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Deflecting Swat by paying {0}, changing any of the remaining Felidar Guardian triggers not targeting Agrus Kos to target Agrus Kos instead.
Repeat from step 6.

2921-3055-3175.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2315-2573-3946.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

3809-4893-5041-5184.description:
Activate Deadeye Plunderers by paying {U}{B}, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2808-3094.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Enduring Scalelord.
2808-3094.description:
Cast Enduring Scalelord by paying {4}{G}{W}.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's third ability by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Enduring Scalelord spell.
Resolve both Enduring Scalelord spells.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Enduring Scalelord.
The Enduring Scalelord who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 5.

662-1061-2043.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
662-1061-2043.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Timestream Navigator to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator that is a 1/1 Soldier creature.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2136-3433-4688.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
2136-3433-4688.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Hornet Queen.
When the Hornet Queen tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating twenty 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, Orthion triggers, causing you to sacrfiice the Hornet Queen tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

749-2178-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three additional creatures, one of which must be nontoken.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Whisper.
749-2178-4283.description:
Activate Lena by sacrificing it.
Lena dies, triggering Whisper, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the Lena ability, causing creatures you control with power less than Lena's power to gain indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures.
The creatures die, triggering Whisper twice, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the Whisper ability from step 4, returning Lena from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Lena enters the battlefield, creating at least three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

3003-4432-5187.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six artifacts.
3003-4432-5187.description:
Cast Leashling by paying {0}.
Leashling enters the battlefield, triggering Guardian Project, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Leashling by putting a card from your hand on top of your library, returning Leashling to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

337-776-1329-1834.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-1834.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Briber's Purse to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Briber's Purse.
Cast Briber's Purse.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

147-1465-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-1465-5256.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1495-3005.notablePrerequisites: Triskelion has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-3005.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls.
Triskelion triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
